newsitem.title: FRANCE: Film producer Salkind dies in Paris, aged 75.
newsitem.headline: Film producer Salkind dies in Paris, aged 75.

text.p: International film producer Alexander Salkind, who produced, or co-produced, the first three films of the highly successful "Superman" series has died in Paris, his agent said on Thursday. He was 75.
Salkind also produced, or co-produced, Orson Welles' film version of Kafka's "The Trial" as well as Richard Lester's "The Three Musketeers."

Born of Russian origin in Danzig (now Gdansk, Poland), Salkind was the son of Mikhail Salkind who in the late 1920s and early 1930s produced the first films in which actresses Greta Garbo and Marlene Dietrich appeared, his agent said.
